programme.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programme.desc: In a special edition of Border Security, there is a conniption in Customs. Will love conquer all for a Romeo who has found love? And a passenger insists he is searched. Narrated by Grant Bowler.

programme.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programme.desc: The search for clues to identify a man begins. Elsewhere, the contents of a parcel that a passenger has brought has Quarantine completely baffled. Then, why is a passenger trying to sweet talk his way into the country? Narrated by Grant Bowler.

programme.title: Family Matters
programme.desc: After Seth attempted to sell his father's business out from under him, Les cannot forgive or forget his son's betrayal. The shop can't function without Les, but he seems to have checked out and locked himself in his office, refusing to speak to anyone. When a fight on the floor gets tossed outside, the brawl doesn't end. When the parking lot rumble rolls out of control, the Golds find themselves in the line of fire.

programme.title: Pay To Play
programme.desc: When a rare guitar finds its way into the shop, the Golds can't decide if it's the real deal or a fake. It could be worth thousands, but coughing up cash on a phony could hit a sour note. With no time to call in an expert, Seth and Les must go with their guts. Meanwhile, Ashley faces off with a customer - not with words, but with words, but with weapons, and a wrestling legend visits American Jewellery with a special proposition.

programme.title: Unforgiven
programme.desc: When Rich commits a fireable offence at the jewellery counter, Seth pushes for forgiveness but his dad refuses. Will the disagreement spark a full-on father-son fight? Meanwhile, some bad manners in the pawn line leads to a battle with Ashley, and a kooky cowboy shows off his "horse" to Les.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: One of the largest train disasters in US history. A freight train rumbling through the calm suburb of San Bernardino, California, derails and crashes, destroying homes and taking lives. Less than two weeks later a pipeline, weakened in the clean-up of the derailment, explodes.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: On 23 November, 1996, Ethiopian Airlines Flight 961 was hijacked by three Ethiopians seeking political asylum. The pilot attempted to trick the hijackers by secretly changing the flight route demanded. programme.title: Air Crash Investigations

They report the gunfire to the tower and moments later, the aircraft falls into a steep dive and crashes into a remote field. programme.desc: Peppa gets her very first Playgroup Star in school for drawing a wonderful picture of her house!

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep

programme.title: Numberblocks

programme.title: Peppa Pig
